children: announced on Thursday that it is on track to exceed the midpoint of its fiscal fourth-quarter 2026 revenue guidance of $1.6M.
On August 17, 2026, the company guided to revenue of $1.4M to $1.8M for the quarter ending September 30, 2026.
The company said the improvement is broad-based across both wireless systems and connectivity businesses.

Mobix Labs’ wireless systems manufacturing business is expected to deliver a significant increase in revenue over the fiscal third quarter that ended June 30, 2026, and demand from military and defense customers continues to trend positively.
In addition to higher revenue, the company expects a substantial sequential increase in gross margin percentage, reflecting higher production volumes and a stronger product mix.

title: Mobix Labs expects Q4 revenue to exceed $1.6M
